Hi Michelangelo,

Thanks for checking in. I found your Magic M. 40T order, Shop····. It's paid and hasn't shipped yet.

I can't honestly promise November 21. I'm sorry nobody wrote to you about this sooner. The first run of units was held up when Magic M. stopped production to fix a control board issue. That's fixed now and the final version is approved. Production isn't split into batches any more. All 300 units are being built and shipped together, so your batch 6 date doesn't apply the way it did when you ordered. Magic M. expected the units to leave the factory on November 12, but they haven't reached our warehouse yet. We set dates we couldn't keep and didn't keep you updated, and that's on us.

I've asked the team for the current date. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET and will email you the answer at the address on your order. You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status. When your miner ships, we'll email you the tracking number.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Sarah

Did you hear from the team about the shipment date?

Regards,

Michelangelo S.

Hi Michelangelo,

Not yet, I'm afraid, and I'm sorry you've had to follow up. I checked your order Shop···· again just now. Your Magic M. 40T is paid and set aside for you, but the units still haven't reached our warehouse, and we don't have a newer ship date yet.

Your question about the current date is still with the team. They're offline now and pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET. They'll reply here by email as soon as they have a date. When your miner ships, we'll email you the tracking number.

You can also follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
